display.text:
app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
        app:cardElevation="0dp"
        app:strokeColor="?attr/colorOutline"
        app:strokeWidth="1dp"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/frame_search">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:padding="10dp">

            <com.google.android.material.textview.MaterialTextView
                android:id="@+id/status_line"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodySmall" />

            <!-- Always visible. It used to start "gone" and open only on a
                 tap, which meant the strip showed a row of bare ticks: the
                 user could see that four things had a state but not what they
                 were or what they cost. The detail is the whole point. -->
            <com.google.android.material.textview.MaterialTextView
                android:id="@+id/status_paths"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
                android:lineSpacingExtra="2dp"
                android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.LabelSmall"
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurfaceVariant" />

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                android:orientation="horizontal">

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/folders_button"
                    style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TonalButton"
                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginEnd="6dp"
                    android:text="@string/folders_open_list"
                    android:textSize="12sp" />

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/data_root_button"
                    style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.OutlinedButton"
                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/status_change_folder"
                    android:textSize="12sp" />

            </LinearLayout>

                <!-- Folder cards, on the games screen itself. The dedicated screen
                     still exists for the detailed view, but "which folders do I
                     have and how big are they" should not require navigating away
                     from the games. Hidden when nothing is configured. -->
                <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
                    android:id="@+id/folder_cards"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    android:clipToPadding="false"
                    android:orientation="horizontal"
                    android:visibility="gone"
                    app:layoutManager="androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager" />

        </LinearLayout>

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <androidx.swiperefreshlayout.widget.SwipeRefreshLayout
        android:id="@+id/swipe_refresh"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/status_strip"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        >

        <RelativeLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent"
            >

            <com.google.android.material.textview.MaterialTextView
                android:id="@+id/notice_text"
                style="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodyLarge"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:padding="@dimen/spacing_large"
                android:text="@string/empty_gamelist"
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnBackground"
                android:visibility="gone"
                />

            <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
                android:id="@+id/grid_games"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:clipToPadding="false"
                android:scrollbarStyle="outsideOverlay"
                android:scrollbars="vertical"
                android:fadeScrollbars="true"
                android:paddingHorizontal="4dp"
                android:paddingVertical="4dp"
                />


        </RelativeLayout>

    </androidx.swiperefreshlayout.widget.SwipeRefreshLayout>

    <com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.ExtendedFloatingActionButton
        android:id="@+id/launch_qlaunch"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_margin="16dp"
        android:contentDescription="Launch QLaunch"
        android:text="@string/qlaunch_applet"
        app:icon="@drawable/ic_home"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"

- `refreshStatusStrip()` → `SetupStatus.games()` → `scanOneFolder` plus
  `whyNotGames()` → `diagnoseRom` (a full header parse per file)
- `refreshFolderCards()` → `GameFolderScanner.scan()` (ContentResolver

And a leftover default `game_path` (or a parent stacked on its child)
sent those walks through `nand` / `load` / `cache` / `sdmc` — the tree
`ensureLayout()` itself creates. That is the hang that looked like
"infinite search" and the crash that killed the process before the UI
was up.

**Fix**

- Startup shows the cached list only. A walk happens on pull-to-refresh
  or when the user adds a folder.
- The status strip and folder cards read the cache. They do not touch
  the document provider.
- No default game folder. `game_path` is deleted, never re-added.

**Proof** — `tests/LazyScanTest.kt`.

## v21 — the launcher showed one game and would not open the rest

**Reported:** «одну игру видит а остальные не видит а раз не видит то и не
открывает либо проблема в том что лаунчер не прокручивается влево вправо может
поэтому не видит».

The guess in the report — that the rail does not scroll — is the one thing that
was **not** wrong.

### Cause (mine)

`renderLauncher()` built the carousel out of `visibleGames()`, and that function
applies the search box and the filter chips of the **Список** tab:

```js
RAIL_LIST = visibleGames();   // поиск и FILTER — принадлежности «Списка»
```

Type anything into «Найти игру…», or leave a chip on «Сейв», and the carousel
shrank to whatever survived the filter. The other games were not off-screen —
they were not in the rail at all, so the dock's «Запустить» could not reach them
either.

Worse, `FILTER = 'fresh'` produced an **empty** rail and the message «нет игр —
откройте Список и добавьте папку» with a full library sitting behind it.

Scrolling was never broken: with 8 games the rail scrolls 623 px and ‹ › both
work. What made it *look* broken is the presentation — the scrollbar is hidden
(`scrollbar-width:none`) and only ~1.5 slides fit (`padding: 8px 18vw`, `.slide`
is `min(42vw, 220px)`), so a single tile on screen is the normal appearance of a
carousel holding many games.

### Fix

`railGames()` returns the whole library; the search box and the chips stay in
«Список», which is the tab they belong to. Both go through the same
`sortGames()`, so the two tabs cannot drift apart in order. The dock prints
`3 / 12`, so the size of the library is on screen and one tile can never again be
read as «одна игра».

### Proof

Measured in Chromium against the real page — one library of 8 games, six states:

```
                                  rail slides   list rows
search "номер 3" in Список              1            1    <- the report
filter Сейв (one game has a save)       1            1    <- the report
filter Не играли                        0            0    <- "нет игр" over 8 games
after the fix, every state              8            as filtered
```

`tests/LauncherRailTest.kt` models the logic and then checks the shipped page:
it fails on the old file (4 checks) and passes on the new one. It also asserts
that `docs/library.html` and `patch/android/assets/library.html` are
byte-identical — the APK is served the second one, so a fix applied to only the
first would never reach the phone.

**Files:** `docs/library.html`, `patch/android/assets/library.html`,
`tests/LauncherRailTest.kt`

---

## Open / unproven

- **Crash a few seconds into Blade Chimera (NSP).** Not reproduced; no device logs. The
  launch report now records the loader status and shows it as the first line, so the next
  occurrence should name its own cause.
- **20 FPS in menus vs 40 in game.** Not explained. Presentation logic is shared.
- **Firmware compression is impossible.** Measured on 200 MB: `xz -9` produced 209,768,460
  bytes from 209,766,400 — 2 KB *larger*. NCA content is encrypted, so it is incompressible.

31:      * Прошёл ли хоть один скан за этот запуск.
32:      *
33:      * Без этого пустой cachedGameList не отличить от "эмулятор ещё не
34:      * смотрел": и то и другое даёт размер 0. Панель состояния принимала
35:      * второе за первое и писала "распознано 0 - проверь ключи", когда
36:      * проверять было нечего.
37:      */
38:     @Volatile
39:     var hasScanned = false
40:         private set
41: 
42:     private lateinit var preferences: SharedPreferences
43: 
44:     fun getGames(): List<Game> {
45:         val games = mutableListOf<Game>()
46:         // Dropped before every scan, so a game that moved does not keep the
47:         // folder it used to be in.
48:         runCatching { GameFolders.clear() }
49:         val context = YuzuApplication.appContext
50:         preferences = PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
51: 
52:         val gameDirs = mutableListOf<GameDir>()
53:         // Папка «по умолчанию» больше не появляется. Старый ключ game_path
54:         // молча добавлялся с deepScan = true и укладывал корень данных
55:         // слоем поверх выбранной папки: обход шёл по nand/load/cache и
56:         // валил запуск.
57:         if (!preferences.getString(KEY_OLD_GAME_PATH, "").isNullOrEmpty()) {
58:             preferences.edit() { remove(KEY_OLD_GAME_PATH) }
59:         }
60:         gameDirs.addAll(NativeConfig.getGameDirs())
61:         val collapsed = GameFolderScanner.collapseLayers(gameDirs.map { it.uriString }).toSet()
62:         if (collapsed.size != gameDirs.size) {
63:             val kept = gameDirs.filter { it.uriString in collapsed }
64:             gameDirs.clear()
65:             gameDirs.addAll(kept)
66:             runCatching { NativeConfig.setGameDirs(gameDirs.toTypedArray()) }
67:         }
68: 
69:         // Ensure keys are loaded so that ROM metadata can be decrypted.
70:         NativeLibrary.reloadKeys()
71: 
72:         // Reset metadata so we don't use stale information
73:         GameMetadata.resetMetadata()
74: 
75:         // Remove previous filesystem provider information so we can get up to date version info
76:         NativeLibrary.clearFilesystemProvider()
77: 
78:         val mountedContainerUris = mutableSetOf<String>()
79:         mountExternalContentDirectories(mountedContainerUris)
80: 
81:         val badDirs = mutableListOf<Int>()
82:         gameDirs.forEachIndexed { index: Int, gameDir: GameDir ->
83:             val gameDirUri = gameDir.uriString.toUri()
84:             val isValid = FileUtil.isTreeUriValid(gameDirUri)
85:             if (isValid) {
86:                 // Upstream's own depth. It was raised to 24 and then 8, and
87:                 // a build at 3 crashed exactly like the others - so the depth
88:                 // was never the fault, and raising it buys nothing until the
89:                 // real one is fixed. Left alone.
90:                 val scanDepth = if (gameDir.deepScan) 3 else 1
91: 
92:                 addGamesRecursive(
93:                     games,
94:                     FileUtil.listFiles(gameDirUri),
95:                     scanDepth,
96:                     mountedContainerUris
97:                 )
98:             } else {
99:                 badDirs.add(index)
100:             }
101:         }
102: 
103:         // Remove all game dirs with insufficient permissions from config
104:         if (badDirs.isNotEmpty()) {
105:             var offset = 0
106:             badDirs.forEach {
107:                 gameDirs.removeAt(it - offset)
108:                 offset++
109:             }
110:         }
111:         NativeConfig.setGameDirs(gameDirs.toTypedArray())
112: 
113:         // Cache list of games found on disk
114:         val serializedGames = mutableSetOf<String>()
115:         games.forEach {
116:             serializedGames.add(Json.encodeToString(it))
117:         }
118:         preferences.edit() {
119:             remove(KEY_GAMES)
120:                 .putStringSet(KEY_GAMES, serializedGames)
121:         }
122: 
123:         cachedGameList = games.toMutableList()
124:         hasScanned = true
125:         return games.toList()
126:     }
127: 
128:     fun restoreContentForGame(game: Game) {
129:         NativeLibrary.reloadKeys()
130: 
131:         val mountedContainerUris = mutableSetOf<String>()
132:         mountExternalContentDirectories(mountedContainerUris)
133:         mountGameFolderContent(Uri.parse(game.path), mountedContainerUris)
134:         NativeLibrary.addFileToFilesystemProvider(game.path)
135:     }
136: 
137:     // File extensions considered as external content, buuut should
138:     // be done better imo.
139:     private val externalContentExtensions = setOf("nsp", "xci")
140: 
141:     private fun scanContentContainersRecursive(
142:         files: Array<MinimalDocumentFile>,
143:         depth: Int,
144:         onContainerFound: (MinimalDocumentFile) -> Unit
145:     ) {
146:         if (depth <= 0) {
147:             return
148:         }
149: 
150:         files.forEach {
151:             if (it.isDirectory) {
152:                 scanContentContainersRecursive(
153:                     FileUtil.listFiles(it.uri),
154:                     depth - 1,
155:                     onContainerFound
156:                 )
157:             } else {
158:                 val extension = FileUtil.getExtension(it.uri).lowercase()
159:                 if (externalContentExtensions.contains(extension)) {
160:                     onContainerFound(it)
161:                 }
162:             }
163:         }
164:     }
165: 
166:     private fun addGamesRecursive(
167:         games: MutableList<Game>,
168:         files: Array<MinimalDocumentFile>,
169:         depth: Int,
170:         mountedContainerUris: MutableSet<String>,
171:         // Only this signature changes, and only with a default, so every
172:         // existing call site still compiles untouched.
173:         folder: String = ""
174:     ) {
175:         if (depth <= 0) {
176:             return
177:         }
178: 
179:         files.forEach {
180:             if (it.isDirectory) {
181:                 if (GameFolderScanner.isLayoutName(it.filename)) return@forEach
182:                 val childFolder = if (folder.isEmpty()) {
183:                     it.filename
184:                 } else {
185:                     "$folder/${it.filename}"
186:                 }
187:                 // Wrapped: one unreadable subdirectory costs that
188:                 // subdirectory, not the whole library.
189:                 runCatching {
190:                     addGamesRecursive(
191:                         games,
192:                         FileUtil.listFiles(it.uri),
193:                         depth - 1,
194:                         mountedContainerUris,
195:                         childFolder
196:                     )
197:                 }.onFailure { e ->
198:                     android.util.Log.e("Symbiosis", "scan failed in $childFolder", e)
199:                 }
200:             } else {
201:                 val extension = FileUtil.getExtension(it.uri).lowercase()
202:                 val filePath = it.uri.toString()
203: 
204:                 if (externalContentExtensions.contains(extension) &&
205:                     mountedContainerUris.add(filePath)) {
206:                     NativeLibrary.addGameFolderFileToFilesystemProvider(filePath)
207:                 }
208: 
209:                 if (Game.extensions.contains(extension)) {
210:                     // getGame is called EXACTLY as upstream calls it - the
211:                     // Game object is upstream's, unchanged. The folder is
212:                     // recorded beside it, keyed by path.
213:                     val game = getGame(it.uri, true, false)
214:                     if (game != null) {
215:                         runCatching { GameFolders.remember(game.path, folder) }
216:                         games.add(game)
217:                     }
218:                 }
219:             }
220:         }
221:     }
222: 
223:     private fun mountExternalContentDirectories(mountedContainerUris: MutableSet<String>) {
224:         val uniqueExternalContentDirs = linkedSetOf<String>()
225:         NativeConfig.getExternalContentDirs().forEach { externalDir ->
226:             if (externalDir.isNotEmpty()) {
227:                 uniqueExternalContentDirs.add(externalDir)
228:             }
229:         }
230: 
231:         for (externalDir in uniqueExternalContentDirs) {
232:             val externalDirUri = externalDir.toUri()
233:             if (FileUtil.isTreeUriValid(externalDirUri)) {
234:                 scanContentContainersRecursive(FileUtil.listFiles(externalDirUri), 3) {
235:                     val containerUri = it.uri.toString()
236:                     if (mountedContainerUris.add(containerUri)) {
237:                         NativeLibrary.addFileToFilesystemProvider(containerUri)
238:                     }
239:                 }
240:             }
241:         }
242:     }
243: 
244:     private fun mountGameFolderContent(gameUri: Uri, mountedContainerUris: MutableSet<String>) {
245:         if (gameUri.scheme == "content") {
246:             val parentUri = getParentDocumentUri(gameUri) ?: return
247:             scanContentContainersRecursive(FileUtil.listFiles(parentUri), 1) {
248:                 val containerUri = it.uri.toString()
249:                 if (mountedContainerUris.add(containerUri)) {
250:                     NativeLibrary.addGameFolderFileToFilesystemProvider(containerUri)
251:                 }
252:             }
253:             return
254:         }
255: 
256:         val gameFile = File(gameUri.path ?: gameUri.toString())
257:         val parentDir = gameFile.parentFile ?: return
258:         parentDir.listFiles()?.forEach { sibling ->
259:             if (!sibling.isFile) {
260:                 return@forEach
261:             }
262: 
263:             val extension = sibling.extension.lowercase()
264:             if (externalContentExtensions.contains(extension)) {
265:                 val containerUri = Uri.fromFile(sibling).toString()
266:                 if (mountedContainerUris.add(containerUri)) {
267:                     NativeLibrary.addGameFolderFileToFilesystemProvider(containerUri)
268:                 }
269:             }
270:         }
271:     }
272: 
273:     private fun getParentDocumentUri(uri: Uri): Uri? {
274:         return try {
275:             val documentId = DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(uri)
276:             val separatorIndex = documentId.lastIndexOf('/')
277:             if (separatorIndex == -1) {
278:                 null
279:             } else {
280:                 val parentDocumentId = documentId.substring(0, separatorIndex)
281:                 DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(uri, parentDocumentId)
282:             }
283:         } catch (_: Exception) {
284:             null
285:         }
286:     }
287: 
288:     fun getGame(
289:         uri: Uri,
290:         addedToLibrary: Boolean,
291:         registerFilesystemProvider: Boolean = true
292:     ): Game? {
293:         val filePath = uri.toString()
294:         if (!GameMetadata.getIsValid(filePath)) {
295:             return null
296:         }
297: 
298:         if (registerFilesystemProvider) {
299:             // Needed to update installed content information
300:             NativeLibrary.addFileToFilesystemProvider(filePath)
301:         }
302: 
303:         var name = GameMetadata.getTitle(filePath)
304: 
305:         // If the game's title field is empty, use the filename.
306:         if (name.isEmpty()) {
307:             name = FileUtil.getFilename(uri)
308:         }
309:         var programId = GameMetadata.getProgramId(filePath)
310: 
311:         // If the game's ID field is empty, use the filename without extension.
312:         if (programId.isEmpty()) {
313:             programId = name.substring(0, name.lastIndexOf("."))
314:         }
315: 
316:         val newGame = Game(
317:             name,
318:             filePath,
319:             programId,
320:             GameMetadata.getDeveloper(filePath),
321:             GameMetadata.getVersion(filePath, false),
322:             GameMetadata.getIsHomebrew(filePath)
323:         )
324: 
325:         if (addedToLibrary) {
326:             val addedTime = preferences.getLong(newGame.keyAddedToLibraryTime, 0L)
327:             if (addedTime == 0L) {
328:                 preferences.edit()
329:                     .putLong(newGame.keyAddedToLibraryTime, System.currentTimeMillis())
330:                     .apply()
331:             }
332:         }
333: 
334:         return newGame
335:     }
336: }

18:  *
19:  * Every check is a filesystem or native query, never a remembered flag. A
20:  * remembered flag is what made the app insist a folder was "already added"
21:  * after the user had removed it.
22:  */
23: object SetupStatus {
24: 
25:     data class Item(
26:         val labelRes: Int,
27:         val present: Boolean,
28:         /** Where it lives, or why it is missing. Shown under the label. */
29:         val detail: String,
30:         /**
31:          * Bytes this item occupies, or null when size is meaningless for it
32:          * (the driver is not a file this build owns).
33:          *
34:          * Kept separate from [detail] so the strip can show "Прошивка ✓ 312 MB"

36:          */

38:     )
39: 
40:     /** Keys, firmware, driver, games, saves, shader cache - in the order they matter. */

45:     private fun root(): String? = runCatching {

54:         // truncated or wrong-firmware prod.keys is present but useless, and
55:         // saying "yes" to it sends the user hunting for the wrong problem.
56:         val onDisk = prod?.isFile == true && (prod.length() > 0)
57:         return Item(
58:             labelRes = R.string.status_keys,
59:             present = onDisk && loaded,
60:             detail = when {
61:                 !onDisk -> "prod.keys — нет"
62:                 !loaded -> "prod.keys есть, но не читается"
63:                 else -> dir ?: ""
64:             },
65:             bytes = if (onDisk) prod?.length() else null
66:         )
67:     }
68: 
69:     fun firmware(): Item {

195: 
196:     /** One-line summary for a collapsed strip. */
197:     fun summary(context: Context): String {

448:      * launching something wrong.

450:     fun childUri(treeUriString: String, entry: Entry): Uri? = runCatching {
451:         val tree = Uri.parse(treeUriString)
452:         val rootId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)
453:         val suffix = if (entry.relativePath.isEmpty()) entry.name
454:                      else entry.relativePath + "/" + entry.name
455:         val childId = if (rootId.endsWith("/")) rootId + suffix else "$rootId/$suffix"
456:         DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree, childId)
457:     }.getOrNull()
458: 
459:     /** The part of the path a person would call the folder's name. */
460:     fun displayNameOf(uriString: String): String {
461:         val decoded = runCatching { Uri.decode(uriString) }.getOrDefault(uriString)
462:         val tail = decoded.substringAfterLast(':', decoded.substringAfterLast('/'))
463:         return tail.substringAfterLast('/').ifBlank { decoded }
464:     }
465: 
466:     /**
467:      * Total bytes under a plain filesystem directory.
468:      *
469:      * Keys, firmware, saves and the shader cache live in the data root as
470:      * ordinary files, not behind a document tree, so they are measured with
471:      * [java.io.File] rather than the content resolver. Returns 0 for a missing
472:      * directory, which is the honest answer for "nothing installed".
473:      */
474:     fun directoryBytes(path: String?): Long {
475:         if (path.isNullOrBlank()) return 0L
476:         val root = java.io.File(path)
477:         if (!root.exists()) return 0L
478:         if (root.isFile) return root.length()
479: 
480:         var total = 0L
481:         var guard = 0
482:         val queue = ArrayDeque<java.io.File>()
483:         queue.add(root)
484:         while (queue.isNotEmpty() && guard < MAX_DIRECTORIES) {
485:             guard++
486:             val entries = queue.removeFirst().listFiles() ?: continue
487:             for (entry in entries) {
488:                 if (entry.isDirectory) queue.add(entry) else total += entry.length()
489:             }
490:         }
491:         return total
492:     }
493: 
494:     /** Formats bytes the way a storage screen would. */
495:     fun humanSize(bytes: Long): String {
496:         if (bytes <= 0) return "0 MB"
497:         val gb = bytes / 1_073_741_824.0
498:         if (gb >= 1.0) return String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f GB", gb)
499:         val mb = bytes / 1_048_576.0
500:         if (mb >= 1.0) return String.format(Locale.US, "%.0f MB", mb)
501:         return String.format(Locale.US, "%.0f KB", bytes / 1024.0)
502:     }
503: 
504:     /** Stops a symlink loop or an absurd tree from hanging the scan. */
505:     private const val MAX_DIRECTORIES = 400
506: 
507:     /**
508:      * Потолок на длину списка файлов.
509:      *
510:      * Не про «столько игр не бывает», а про память: список целиком лежит
511:      * в куче и целиком уходит в адаптер. Три тысячи строк экран всё равно
512:      * не покажет осмысленно, а вылет по нехватке памяти покажет.
513:      */
514:     private const val MAX_ENTRIES = 3000
515: }

190:     private fun encodeIcon(path: String, maxPx: Int, quality: Int): String = runCatching {
191:         val raw = GameMetadata.getIcon(path)
192:         if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty()) return@runCatching ""
193:         val bounds = android.graphics.BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
194:         android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(raw, 0, raw.size, bounds)
195:         if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0) return@runCatching ""
196:         var sample = 1
197:         while (bounds.outWidth / sample > maxPx || bounds.outHeight / sample > maxPx) sample *= 2
198:         val opts = android.graphics.BitmapFactory.Options().apply {
199:             inSampleSize = sample
200:             inPreferredConfig = android.graphics.Bitmap.Config.RGB_565
201:         }
202:         val bmp = android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(raw, 0, raw.size, opts)
203:             ?: return@runCatching ""
204:         val out = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
205:         bmp.compress(android.graphics.Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, quality, out)
206:         android.util.Base64.encodeToString(out.toByteArray(), android.util.Base64.NO_WRAP)
207:     }.getOrDefault("")

317:     data class SaveProbe(val path: String, val bytes: Long)
318: 
319:     /**
320:      * Настоящий сейв — файлы с данными в nand/user/save/<user>/<titleid>/.
321:      * Папку слота Eden создаёт при первом запуске, даже если слоты пустые.
322:      * Именно поэтому на карточке писало «сейв есть», а в игре — NEW GAME.
323:      */
324:     fun saveProbe(game: Game): SaveProbe {
325:         val root = runCatching { DirectoryInitialization.userDirectory }.getOrNull()
326:             ?: return SaveProbe("", 0)
327:         val nand = File(root, "nand/user/save")
328:         val tid = titleIdHex(game.programId)
329:         var total = 0L
330:         var path = ""
331:         runCatching {
332:             val sd = game.saveDir
333:             if (sd.isNotBlank()) {
334:                 val b = fileBytes(File(sd))
335:                 if (b > 0) { total += b; path = sd }
336:             }
337:         }
338:         if (tid.isNotEmpty() && nand.isDirectory) {
339:             nand.listFiles()?.forEach { user ->
340:                 if (!user.isDirectory || user.name == "0000000000000000") return@forEach
341:                 val folder = File(user, tid)
342:                 val b = fileBytes(folder)
343:                 if (b > 0) {
344:                     total += b
345:                     if (path.isEmpty()) path = folder.absolutePath
346:                 }
347:             }
348:         }
349:         return SaveProbe(path, total)
350:     }

354:         if (looksLikeTitleId(raw)) return raw.uppercase()
355:         val n = raw.toLongOrNull() ?: return ""
356:         if (n == 0L) return ""
357:         return n.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(16, '0')

360:     fun realSaveBytes(nandSave: File): Long {
361:         if (!nandSave.isDirectory) return 0
362:         var total = 0L
363:         nandSave.listFiles()?.forEach { user ->
364:             if (!user.isDirectory || user.name == "0000000000000000") return@forEach
365:             total += fileBytes(user)

370:     private fun fileBytes(dir: File): Long {
371:         if (!dir.exists()) return 0
372:         if (dir.isFile) return dir.length()
373:         var sum = 0L
374:         val q = ArrayDeque<File>()
375:         q.add(dir)
376:         var steps = 0
377:         while (q.isNotEmpty() && steps < 80) {
378:             steps++
379:             val kids = q.removeFirst().listFiles() ?: continue
380:             for (k in kids) {
381:                 if (k.isFile) sum += k.length() else if (k.isDirectory) q.add(k)
382:             }
383:         }
384:         return sum
385:     }
386: 
387:     private fun dirHasFiles(dir: File): Boolean {
388:         val q = ArrayDeque<File>()
389:         q.add(dir)
390:         var steps = 0
391:         while (q.isNotEmpty() && steps < 40) {
392:             steps++
393:             val cur = q.removeFirst()
394:             val kids = cur.listFiles() ?: continue
395:             for (k in kids) {
396:                 if (k.isFile && k.length() > 0) return true
397:                 if (k.isDirectory) q.add(k)
398:             }
399:         }
400:         return false
401:     }

475:     internal fun formatLastPlayed(ms: Long, now: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): String {
476:         if (ms <= 0L) return ""
477:         fun startOfDay(ts: Long): Long {
478:             val cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance()
479:             cal.timeInMillis = ts
480:             cal.set(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0)
481:             cal.set(java.util.Calendar.MINUTE, 0)
482:             cal.set(java.util.Calendar.SECOND, 0)
483:             cal.set(java.util.Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0)
484:             return cal.timeInMillis
485:         }
486:         val startToday = startOfDay(now)
487:         val day = 24L * 3600_000
488:         return when {
489:             ms >= startToday -> {
490:                 val cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance()
491:                 cal.timeInMillis = ms
492:                 "сегодня %02d:%02d".format(cal.get(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY), cal.get(java.util.Calendar.MINUTE))
493:             }
494:             ms >= startToday - day -> "вчера"
495:             else -> {
496:                 val cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance()
497:                 cal.timeInMillis = ms
498:                 "%02d.%02d".format(cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH), cal.get(java.util.Calendar.MONTH) + 1)
499:             }
500:         }
501:     }

parts.text:
Very important finding: `LivePanel.rememberedGames()` at line 85-106 returns `emptyList()` if `!keysPresent()`. So if prod.keys are not loaded/present, the WebView launcher shows ZERO games — the panel's game list is empty. This is a real "one game"/empty-list risk: keys gate.

Also `rememberedGames` prefers `GameHelper.cachedGameList` and only falls back to prefs. It never scans disk. So the WebView launcher shows exactly what the last scan produced. If the last scan found 1 game, only 1 shows. There is no rescanning from the panel except `Symbiosis.rescan()` (line 438) which calls `gamesViewModel.reloadGames(false)`.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds and runs the host test suite against a patched Eden checkout.
#
# Two things here are easy to get wrong and both make the suite worthless:
#
#  1. Do NOT put <eden>/src/common on the include path. Eden ships its own
#     common/assert.h, which shadows the standard <cassert>; every assert()
#     then expands to nothing and the tests pass without checking anything.
#     Only -I<eden>/src is correct.
#
#  2. Eden's logging is a real dependency of the layer. Rather than linking
#     half the emulator, a tiny stub supplies FmtLogMessageImpl.
#
# Usage: bash tools/run_tests.sh [--eden <dir>]
set -uo pipefail

EDEN_DIR="${EDEN_DIR:-/tmp/citest}"
# A test that will not link proves nothing. Allow a known few (they need most
# of video_core), but fail if the number grows - that means the environment is
# broken, not the code.
MAX_SKIP="${MAX_SKIP:-99}"
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --max-skip) MAX_SKIP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --eden) EDEN_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

E="$EDEN_DIR"
S="$E/src/common/symbiosis"
[ -d "$S" ] || { echo "patched Eden not found at $E (run tools/apply_patch.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

# Eden's logging.h needs fmt 10 (format.get()); Ubuntu ships fmt 9. Point
# FMT_INCLUDE at a fmt 10 checkout to build against that instead. FMT_HEADER_ONLY
# avoids needing the compiled library at all.
FMT_FLAGS=""
if [ -n "${FMT_INCLUDE:-}" ]; then
  FMT_FLAGS="-isystem $FMT_INCLUDE -DFMT_HEADER_ONLY"
  LINK_FMT=""
else
  LINK_FMT="-lfmt"
fi
BUILD=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$BUILD"' EXIT

# Minimal stand-in for Eden's logging backend.
cat > "$BUILD/log_stub.cpp" <<'STUB'
#include <cstdarg>
#include <string_view>
#include "common/logging.h"
namespace Common::Log {
void FmtLogMessageImpl(Class, Level, const char*, unsigned int, const char*,
                       fmt::string_view, const fmt::format_args&) {}
} // namespace Common::Log
STUB

CORE="$S/symbiosis_log.cpp $S/symbiosis_types.cpp $BUILD/log_stub.cpp"
# Settings::values lives here; several tests read or write real settings.
SETTINGS="$E/src/common/settings.cpp"

deps_for() {
  case "$1" in
    t_mali|t_parse) echo "$S/mali_tuning.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_fw)           echo "$S/firmware_vault.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_rom)          echo "$S/rom_tools.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_save)         echo "$S/save_guard.cpp $S/thermal_monitor.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_guard)        echo "$CORE" ;;
    t_modes)        echo "$S/auto_modes.cpp $S/device_profiles.cpp $SETTINGS $CORE" ;;
    t_uaf)          echo "$S/memory_governor.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_v12)          echo "$S/device_profiles.cpp $S/auto_modes.cpp $SETTINGS $CORE" ;;
    t_fps)          echo "$S/device_profiles.cpp $S/auto_modes.cpp $SETTINGS $CORE" ;;
    *)              echo "" ;;
  esac
}

pass=0; fail=0; skip=0; failed=""
for f in "$HERE"/tests/t_*.cpp; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  n=$(basename "$f" .cpp)
  # shellcheck disable=SC2046
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  if g++ -std=c++20 -O1 $FMT_FLAGS -I"$E/src" -o "$BUILD/$n" "$f" $(deps_for "$n") $LINK_FMT \
       > "$BUILD/$n.err" 2>&1; then
    if out=$("$BUILD/$n" 2>&1); then
      echo "  PASS  $n — $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -1)"; pass=$((pass+1))
    else
      echo "  FAIL  $n"; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -5 | sed 's/^/        /'
      fail=$((fail+1)); failed="$failed $n"
    fi
  else
    # A test whose dependencies are not wired up is reported, never hidden.
    # A test that will not build is reported with the real reason, never a
    # blank. An empty parenthesis told me nothing on CI and cost a whole run.
    reason=$(grep -m1 -E "undefined reference|error:|fatal error:" "$BUILD/$n.err" | head -1)
    echo "  SKIP  $n"
    echo "        reason: ${reason:-unknown}"
    sed 's/^/        | /' "$BUILD/$n.err" | head -6
    skip=$((skip+1))
  fi
done

# Kotlin tests, when a compiler is available.
if command -v kotlinc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for f in "$HERE"/tests/*.kt; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=$(basename "$f" .kt)
    kotlinc "$f" -include-runtime -d "$BUILD/$n.jar" 2>/dev/null
    # Run from the repository root. A test that reads its own subject - as
    # PanelAssetsTest does, checking docs/ and the shell source against the
    # copy of the routing logic it asserts - resolves those paths relative to
    # the working directory, and CI invokes this script from elsewhere. The JS
    # loop below already does this; the Kotlin one did not, so the same test
    # passed locally and failed on the runner.
    if out=$(cd "$HERE" && java -jar "$BUILD/$n.jar" 2>&1); then
      echo "  PASS  $n — $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -1)"; pass=$((pass+1))
    else
      echo "  FAIL  $n"; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -8 | sed 's/^/        /'
      fail=$((fail+1)); failed="$failed $n"
    fi
  done
else
  echo "  note: kotlinc not on PATH, Kotlin tests not run"
fi

# Node tests. The capability layer spawns real interpreters, so these check
# actual process behaviour rather than a mock; they need node on PATH and
# python3 for the Python-runtime cases.
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for f in "$HERE"/tests/*.js; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=$(basename "$f" .js)
    if out=$(cd "$HERE" && node "$f" 2>&1); then
      echo "  PASS  $n — $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -1)"; pass=$((pass+1))
    else
      echo "  FAIL  $n"; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -15 | sed 's/^/        /'
      fail=$((fail+1)); failed="$failed $n"
    fi
  done
else
  echo "  note: node not on PATH, JS tests not run"
fi

echo
echo "passed=$pass failed=$fail skipped=$skip"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ] || { echo "failing:$failed"; exit 1; }
if [ "$skip" -gt "$MAX_SKIP" ]; then
  echo "too many tests could not be built ($skip > $MAX_SKIP): the toolchain is"
  echo "missing something - libfmt-dev, or the patched Eden tree."
  exit 1
fi

An empty scan result never clears the native list — CONFIRMED bug.** `patch/android/ui/GamesFragment.kt:229-233`: ``` gamesViewModel.games.collect(viewLifecycleOwner) { if (it.isNotEmpty()) { setAdapter(it) } } ``` An empty emission (R1, permission loss, or a removed folder) leaves the previous adapter list on screen, while `:224-227` makes `noticeText` visible — the "no games" notice renders over a stale list. This is exactly the "it knows the files are there but shows one/zero" family of reports. **R4. Rail built from the filtered list — HISTORICAL, verified fixed.** `docs/BUGS.md:226-285` documents the exact user report («одну игру видит… лаунчер не прокручивается влево вправо»). Cause: `renderLauncher()` used `visibleGames()`. Current `railGames()` (`:512-514`) uses the full library, and `tests/LauncherRailTest.kt` asserts the shipped HTML — including that `docs/` and `patch/android/assets/` copies are byte-identical. **The remaining part of that report is still true as presentation:** `padding:8px 18vw` + `min(42vw,220px)` slides + hidden scrollbar (`BUGS.md:252-256`) means a full library still *looks* like one tile. **R5. Depth cap hides one-folder-per-game libraries — CONFIRMED by design.** `GameHelper.kt:110` uses depth 1 when `deepScan` is off. A library organised as `Games/GameName/game.nsp` yields **0** games. Pinned as intended by `tests/GameCountTest.kt` ("depth 1 misses a nested game, as upstream does"). **R6. Hard caps — CONFIRMED.** `MAX_DIRECTORIES = 400` (`GameFolderScanner.kt:505`, used at `:257`, `:368`, `:484`) and `MAX_ENTRIES = 3000` (`:514`, used at `:73`, `:378`, `:396`). A tree wider/deeper than 400 directories is silently truncated — count and list truncate together, so no drift, but games are missed with no "truncated" indication. Also `LivePanel.kt:377` (`steps < 80`) and `:391` (`steps < 40`) cap save/mode byte walks. **R7. Per-folder counts use path-prefix matching that can silently fail — RISK.** `LivePanel.kt:58-61` matches cached `Game.path` against `GameFolderScanner.pathOf(dir.uriString)`. `pathOf` (`:177-182`) normalizes SAF URIs by taking the text after the last `:`; a plain `/storage/emulated/0/...` path has no `:` prefix handling difference, but a URI whose percent-encoding differs from the stored `Game.path` yields no prefix match → folder reads "0 игр" while the library has games. This is the only place where a folder can claim zero while the rail is non-empty. **R8. `rememberedGames()` never scans — CONFIRMED design.** `LivePanel.kt:85-106`. The panel list is a pure mirror of the last native scan; the only trigger is `Symbiosis.rescan()` → `LivePanelFragment.kt:438-442` → `gamesViewModel.reloadGames(false)`. **R9. `patch2` uses stricter format policy — DIVERGENCE (not a bug; the overlays are not combined).** `patch2/android/utils/GameFolderScanner.kt:30` accepts only `{xci, nsp, nca, nro}`; `patch2/android/utils/GameHelper.kt:209` uses upstream `Game.extensions` only. `patch2/tests/MyGamesTest.kt` mirrors that narrower set. Applying `patch2` would drop `nso`, `kip`, and files named `main`/`00` that `patch/` keeps. **R10. `Bridge.rescan()` does not notify the page — CONFIRMED, cosmetic.** `LivePanelFragment.kt:438-442` starts the scan but never calls back into JS. `findGames()` compensates by polling `loadGames()` every 700 ms for up to 20 iterations (`library.html:717-726`). Any other `rescan()` caller gets a silent update. **No confirmed occurrence** of `first()`/`firstOrNull()` truncation, a one-element adapter, or an early `break` in any game-list path. ## 7. Horizontal-navigation risks **H1. The rail has zero custom gesture handling — everything depends on the browser.** `library.html:223-232` only. If the WebView is not Chromium (or scroll-snap is disabled by a plugin), the rail degrades to a plain scroller with no snap and no keyboard support (there is no `keydown`/arrow handling anywhere). **H2. No drag suppression on the cover images — most likely real-world failure.** `.slide img` (`:242`) sets only `width/height/object-fit/display`. There is **no `user-select:none`, no `-webkit-user-drag:none`, no `draggable="false"`, no `-webkit-touch-callout:none`** anywhere in the file (grep for `draggable|user-select|-webkit-touch-callout` returns zero hits). The covers are `data:image/jpeg;base64` `` injected by `fillCover()` (`:800-806`). A long press on a cover is a native image-drag gesture on many Android WebViews, which pre-empts the horizontal swipe. **H3. `scrollIntoView` is the only positioning mechanism** (`:796`, `:816`, `:1393`, `:1495`). `scrollIntoView` scrolls **all scrollable ancestors**; with `block:'nearest'` it normally leaves the page alone, but it is the classic way a rail steals vertical scroll. There is no `rail.scrollTo({left: …})` fallback. **H4. `renderLauncher()` rebuilds the rail wholesale and re-centers — drops the user's place mid-gesture.** Called from three places: `loadGames()` (`:1076`, and `loadGames` runs from `findGames` polling at `:720`, from `onFolderAdded` at `:1129`, from `onSavesPicked` at `:1135`, from folder removal at `:1106`), `showTab('launch')` (`:1390`), and the tools sort/filter bar (`:1476`). Each call replaces `rail.innerHTML` (`:778`) and re-issues `scrollIntoView` in `requestAnimationFrame` (`:794-797`). A 700 ms rescan poll landing mid-swipe resets the rail to `LAUNCH_I`. **H5. `nearestSlide()` measures untransformed boxes while the slides are visually scaled.** `:826` uses `offsetLeft + offsetWidth/2`; `.slide` is `transform:scale(.88)` (`:238`) expanding to `scale(1)` when `.on` (`:241`). The centers are geometrically correct, but the highlighted tile and the tile the user perceives as centred can differ by the transform, and the `transform` is animating over 0.18 s (`:239`) while the 80 ms scroll debounce (`:1487`) fires — so `.on` can land on the previous tile during a fast flick. **H6. Landscape relayout.** `:344-359` switches slides to `min(28vh,180px)` and `padding:6px 44px`, and the rail-wrap to `flex:0 0 36%; max-width:320px` (`:351`). `keepLaunchFrame()` (`:1491-1505`) re-centers on `resize` and twice on `orientationchange`. Combined with `snapTo`'s `scrollIntoView`, a rotation during a fling can leave the rail between two snap points with `.on` set on one of them. **H7. In Kenji space there is no horizontal navigation at all.** `:341` `body.space-kenji #view-launch, #view-games { display:none !important; }` and `:342` hides the tabs; `paintSpaces()` (`:1531-1536`) shows `#view-kenji` with the vertical `#k-grid` (`:1562-1595`). `renderKenjiGrid` has its **own** search box (`:1565-1566`, wired at `:1626`) independent of `visibleGames()` — a second filter surface that can disagree with the Список tab. The «Их APK» button in that bar (`:1629-1632`) acts on `RAIL_LIST[LAUNCH_I]`, i.e. on the **hidden** rail's selection, which is not what the Kenji grid highlights — a genuine cross-surface mismatch. **H8. Portrait native screen has no horizontal pager.** `patch/android/layout/fragment_games.xml:318-359` is `SwipeRefreshLayout` → plain `RecyclerView`. The native carousel exists only in `layout-land/fragment_games.xml:336`. So the only place where a *parent view* could steal a horizontal gesture on the native side is `SwipeRefreshLayout` — I cannot verify its interception rules without the upstream `CarouselRecyclerView`/`SwipeRefreshLayout` sources. **H9. ViewHolder reuse across view types is guarded, but carousel restore is best-effort.** `GamesFragment.kt:328-330` forces a non-carousel view type on holders left over from the carousel, and `:356-362` re-runs `notifyLaidOut`/`setupCarousel`. `lastScrollPosition` (`:53` in the ViewModel) is a single `Int` shared by all view types, so switching grid→carousel→list→carousel restores a position computed for a different layout manager. ## 8.
